question: What musical possession and serpentine form define the honored deity?
premises: The deity possesses all percussion instruments.
The deity has the form of a serpent.
Obeisance is offered to these aspects.
inference: The deity is honored as master of all percussion and as having a serpentine form.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one possessing all percussion instruments; obeisance to the one in serpent form.
